content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Department of Neonatology at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur, for an ICMR-funded Extramural Research Project under Principal Investigator Dr. Sushil Choudhary, Associate Professor. The initial tenure of the appointment will be for 6 months, which may be extended further based on project requirements, availability of funds, and performance appraisal, subject to applicable ICMR and institutional rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate should be willing and available to work in rotational shifts, including night duties, weekends, and holidays, as per the requirement of the project.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled application format and Bio-data All relevant original documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience Passport size photograph No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, if working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM on 02.11.2026. Closing time to report for the interview is 10:00 AM on the same day, after which no additional candidates will be entertained. A Screening/Scrutiny Test or written test may be conducted, if required, for shortlisting/selection of candidates for final interview depending on the number of applicants. Candidates must appear in person for the Walk-In-Interview along with all relevant original documents and self-attested photocopies.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 02.11.2026.

faq.answer: Reporting time starts at 9:00 AM and the closing time to report is 10:00 AM on the date of the interview.

faq.answer: The venue is the Model Early Intervention Centre (MEIC), Second Floor, OPD Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur, Basni, Phase 2nd, Jodhpur – 342005.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Project Nurse III?
